notes: Branch sections in this document carry no standalone branch ID token; the heading supplies only name, class, and cost. The id is composed as <weaponId>-<branch-name-kebab-case>.

Section prose states no prerequisite. prerequisites is empty per docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md:50,66 ("Branches have no stat-rank prerequisites"; no rank, level, time, or boss prerequisite).
Exclusivity and irreversibility are not restated in this section; they come from docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md:56,68 and apply to all 45 branches.

Damage and attack rate are explicitly unchanged and the defensive value is not quantified (line 317), so favorableSceneEffect.magnitude is null; only the class-level Functional range at docs/71-initial-weapon-numeric-catalog.md:503 applies.

exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorableSceneEffect.qualitative: converts distributed fire into a mobile defensive screen

rules.text: Pods prioritize enemies within 4M of the mech, then fall back to normal nearest-target behavior.
Every hit pushes an ordinary enemy 0.8M away from the mech and staggers it for 0.25 s. Bosses and elites use global control resistance.
Damage and attack rate are unchanged; the branch converts distributed fire into a mobile defensive screen.
